title: list_open_events

token_id.description: Registry token key (reg.tokens), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. bitcoin:BTC in «Bitcoin (BTC) · bitcoin:BTC».

entity_id.description: Registry entity key (reg.entities), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. uniswap in «Uniswap · uniswap».

query.description: Words of the development, e.g. «ETF approval»; events whose statement contains any of them are kept and ranked by how many match. Null or omitted: no text filter.

days.description: Activity window in days (>0, ≤90). Null or omitted: the 3-day routing window. Widen it to see older open events of the same story.

offset.description: Page start: the next_offset of the previous page. Null or omitted: 0.

description: List open events for routing or duplicate checks: statements, entities, tokens, stages, known-to-us and last-activity times and session associations. Only events with activity (first known, a routed item or a requested review) within the last `days` are listed; the default is the 3-day routing window. token_id and entity_id each also match the registry pair (a token's project, a project's tokens); with both, an event must match both. `query` keeps events whose statement contains any of its words and ranks them by how many match. Results are ordered by relevance, then most recent activity, at most 50 per page; `total` counts every match and `next_offset`, when set, is the `offset` for the next page. Read every page before deciding an item is new. Listing does not modify an event.
